description: The easiest formal specification language and model checker for the full development cycle: requirements analysis, design verification, and model-based testing.
rules: FizzBee specs are Python-like but live in .fizz files; label code fences with `fizz`, not `python`.
Use `oneof` for nondeterministic choice; `any` is a deprecated alias that emits a DeprecationWarning.
Current documentation is at https://fizzbee.io/reference/language/ — prefer it over any pre-release docs.
